events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today. Still bringing that iconic swagger and those unmistakable vocals.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon gave us the timeless message of 'Imagine'. A true classic.

events.title: First iPod unveiled 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple's groundbreaking first iPod was unveiled on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when 1,000 songs in your pocket was mind-blowing? Twenty-five years since the first iPod was unveiled, changing music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the 'Dr. No' premiere in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen in 'Dr. No'. What's your favourite Bond theme?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Monty Python and Fawlty Towers legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese. A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Day
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the expansive and iconic 'White Album'. A double LP full of diverse classics.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the extraordinary Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Day
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a pivotal shift in their sound. An album that changed everything.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since John Lennon was tragically killed in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost John Lennon. His timeless music and message of peace live on.
